projection.basis: Both visitor floor diagrams were visually reviewed as overhead plans of the connected palaces. Courtyard context and stair symbols are classified separately; there is no perspective transform.

transform: translation only, equal x/y units; floor stacking is display-only
review: Official orthographic visitor diagrams p2 and p3 visually checked. Retain actual plan simplification, not surveying precision. Room labels 1-16 were visually transcribed from the rendered plan because the page text extraction omitted them; the PDF encoding mechanism was not assumed. B1/B2 are two actual ceramic-area labels. Separate source wall polygons from arrows, stair treads, pictograms and text. First-floor pale courtyard context fills 37/38 are omitted as floor slabs, while their evidenced stair lines remain. No artwork wall position inferred from room-label center.
